criteria.text: Operates a cloud-based platform for running or serving machine learning models
criteria.rationale: Replicate is an ML infra provider that runs models in the cloud; this separates infrastructure/serving platforms from vendors that only build research models or desktop tools.

criteria.text: Exposes a developer-facing API for invoking models or model endpoints
criteria.rationale: Replicate's core product is an API for developers to run models; requiring an API-focused interface distinguishes developer-targeted infra from end-user apps or consulting services.

criteria.text: Hosts, distributes, or provides access to open-source pre-trained models (a model hub, registry, or marketplace)
criteria.rationale: Replicate emphasizes running open-source AI; this separates peers that enable community/open models from companies that only serve proprietary models.

criteria.text: Positions itself as ML infrastructure (inference/serving/deployment) rather than as a research lab or end-user application
criteria.rationale: Labeling as infrastructure or deployment-focused distinguishes true peers from organizations whose primary focus is model research, consumer apps, or vertical SaaS.

criteria.text: Markets its product toward software developers and engineering teams as primary users
criteria.rationale: Replicate targets developers; this separates developer-focused ML infra providers from companies that primarily sell to data scientists, nontechnical business users, or end consumers.
